brief:
Canada and Croatia joined other world leaders in calling for a two-state solution to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, Middle East Eye reported. The Canadian and Croatian prime ministers added their voices to international condemnation of genocide allegations against Palestinians.

Angola's president separately condemned Israeli settler expansion in occupied Palestinian territories. The statements reflect growing diplomatic pressure on Israel from multiple nations over its military operations and settlement policies.
dek: Canada, Croatia call for two-state solution, Angola condemns settler expansion Canadian and Croatian prime ministers, and Angolan president, joined a chorus of world leaders who have condemned genocide against Palestinians and called for a two-state solution…
title: Canada, Croatia, Angola back two-state solution, condemn settler expansion
